integrity: Analytical proof and exact-rational finite checker are included; finite enumeration does not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Common independent casting probability p in (0,1), position diameter D>0, all delegates available, and strict sufficient tolerance bound for the all-size theorem; the exact three-voter phase diagram only covers equal spacing and tau>2h. General bound is sufficient, not claimed necessary. No mixed equilibria or heterogeneous parameters; independent scientific review not conducted.
title: High-tolerance equilibrium collapse to Hamiltonian cycles in stochastic default delegation
